availability.note: BYD AU Build & Price (bydautomotive.com.au/configurator/byd-sealion-8 301-redirects to this BYD-run configurator host) lists Dynamic FWD at $56,990 on 2026-11-26, one of three grades (Dynamic FWD, Dynamic AWD, Premium AWD). Three grades also per CarExpert, RACV, CarsGuide and the Oct 2026 MY26 spec sheet.

listPrice.note: BYD configurator variant price $56,990, with drive-away computed separately from a postcode (manufacturer price preferred per owner). 'Before on-road costs' in words: CarExpert price-and-specs (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2026-byd-sealion-8-price-and-specs) and CarsGuide review; RACV 'plus on-road costs' with Vic drive-away $60,357.70 against the app's computed $60,263.58 (green-duty), a $94 gap per grade. Configurator's '$4k Cashback Offer' is a campaign and ignored.

batteryKwh.note: MY26 AU spec sheet (version 261026) 'Battery capacity (kWh)' 19.0 for DM-i (BYD Blade LFP). Unlabelled gross vs usable; no source states both. Configurator copy wrongly prints 35.6kWh/359kW under the FWD grade too; the spec sheet is preferred.

rangeKm.note: Spec sheet '*Electric range - NEDC combined cycle (km)' 103. No WLTP figure exists: BYD UK has no Sealion 8 page (404) and Auto Express (22 Sep 2026) says UK not confirmed and quotes NEDC only; BYD Singapore's 'Combined Range (WLTP)' field is blank; NZ also quotes NEDC (Driven). RACV's own estimate is ~88km WLTP-equivalent, not used. NEDC overstates.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 19.0/103x100; no EV-mode figure published. Inherits the NEDC range overstatement and possible gross battery.

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm 103 + 60L tank (spec sheet 'Fuel tank capacity (L)' 60) / 5.3 L/100km x 100 = 1235.1. Electric part is NEDC because no WLTP exists.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: Spec sheet '*Combined fuel consumption - SOC <25% (l/100km)' 5.3: BYD's published charge-sustaining figure (NEDC). No review tested it (CarExpert says it had no time).

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Spec sheet 'Combined fuel consumption - SOC >25%' 1.1 L/100km, at or below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: Combined CO2 24 g/km (aggregator spec listing; the AWD figure taken from the Dynamic AWD listing, same powertrain as Premium AWD); SRO definition at https://www.sro.vic.gov.au/vehicles-and-car-parks/motor-vehicle-duty/understanding-motor-vehicle-duty: green car = combined CO2 120 g/km or less.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Spec sheet 'Boot Capacity (L) 270 / 960 / 1,960'; 270 = all three rows up (RACV, CarsGuide), matching sibling convention (kia-sorento-phev 175 third row up). Measurement method not stated by BYD or reviewers; may be to the roof.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Spec sheet 1,960 L with second and third rows folded (RACV). Method unstated; likely to the roof rather than the belt line - no to-the-cover figure found in CarExpert, Chasing Cars, CarsGuide or RACV.

towKg.note: Spec sheet 'Towing capacity (kg) - braked' 1800; unbraked 750. CarExpert's price-and-specs table prints 750 as braked (its error); RACV agrees with 1800/2000.

warrantyYears.note: BYD AU model page: vehicle 6 years/150,000km; traction battery 8 years/160,000km. Matches BYD reference value 6.

insuranceAnnual.note: Kept at 1850: sits with the seven-seat PHEV cohort - chery-tiggo-9-phev-elite 1800 ($52,990), jaecoo-j8-shs-summit 1950 ($59,990), mazda-cx-80-phev-touring 1850 ($68,100) - and above mazda-cx-60-phev-pure 1700 / mitsubishi-outlander-phev-es 1650 (five-seat-class, refreshed today) for a larger, heavier new-brand seven-seater.

depreciationCurve.note: BYD brand convention used by most BYD rows (Seal 6, Atto 1/2, Sealion 5/6/7, Dolphin, Shark 6), per one curve per brand. The AWD rows previously held steeper bespoke curves ([1,0.73,...] and [1,0.72,...]) with no documented evidence; aligned for consistency.

lowConfidence: byd-sealion-8-dynamic-awd.rangeKm: NEDC 152, no WLTP exists in any market checked (UK, SG, NZ); RACV estimates ~130km WLTP. Same for premium-awd.
byd-sealion-8-*.consumptionKwhPer100km and combinedRangeKm: derived from NEDC range (and an unlabelled battery figure), so understate consumption and overstate combined range.
byd-sealion-8-*.bootLitresSeatsDown: 1,960 L measurement method unstated, probably to the roof not the belt line.
byd-sealion-8-*.fuelConsumptionL100km: BYD's NEDC SOC<25% claim (5.3 / 6.3), untested by any review.
byd-sealion-8-*.isGreenForVicDuty: CO2 22/24 g/km from aggregator listings, not the Green Vehicle Guide; margin to 120 g/km is large.
